generation.shape_rng: SHA256 seed/profile/attempt; independent of setting and requested counts

meta.label_basis: Python claims; native worker executes exact protected Racket before acceptance/export

adapter_episode.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define greens (find-color g 3))
             (define reds (find-color g 2))
             (define eights (find-color g 8))
             (define gr (first (first greens)))
             (define gc (second (first greens)))
             (define offsets
               (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) gr) (- (second p) gc))) eights))
             (define empty (cellmap g (r c v) 0))
             (reduce (lambda (gg red)
                       (let ((rr (first red))
                             (rc (second red)))
                         (reduce (lambda (gx off)
                                   (let ((nr (+ rr (first off)))
                                         (nc (+ rc (second off))))
                                     (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                                         (set-cell gx nr nc 8)
                                         gx)))
                                 gg
                                 offsets)))
                     empty
                     reds)))))
